indicators.url_obfuscation: subdomain 'secure-itcorp.com' used as prefix to malicious domain 'login-verify.co'
indicators.registrar_privacy: domain registered with privacy protection service

examples.detection_method: Detection via advanced email filtering with heuristics identifying the suspicious subdomain and mismatch between sender domain and link domain; URL reputation systems flagging 'login-verify.co' as newly registered and associated with phishing; WAF rule detecting credential submission POST requests to non-corporate domains; user training and simulated phishing exercises raising awareness about subdomain spoofing and urgent password change requests.
